payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the correlations of different ROUGE variants with manual evaluations and other metrics, indicating variability in their effectiveness.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE scores show a large variance in correlations with manual evaluations, affecting their reliability for evaluating scientific summaries.
Keyword-based reduction variants of ROUGE have high correlations, while ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L exhibit the lowest F-score correlations.
Sera evaluation scores correlate better with pyramid scores than all ROUGE variants, indicating that not all ROUGE variants are equally effective.
Many ROUGE variants do not have high correlations with human pyramid scores, suggesting variability in their effectiveness.
